content: {"question":"If I move from GitLab BV in Belgium to GitLab PTY Ltd. in New Zealand, how does my sick leave entitlement change regarding salary continuation and eligibility requirements?","answer":"In Belgium you receive 30 days of full salary continuation regardless of seniority, while in New Zealand you must work 6 months continuously to qualify for 10 days of statutory sick leave, which is paid only after that period.","evidence_a":"30 days full salary continuation (regardless of seniority)","evidence_b":"Eligibility: 10 days statutory sick leave after 6 months continuous employment"}
